card.name: Small words before a descriptive noun
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as a, the, of, to, for, or an opening quote in general web prose, right before a descriptive noun or adjective phrase. Drug-label text is not the setting.

modes.label: Article before a noun
modes.description: A, the or this just before a described thing or sound.

modes.label: Preposition or link before a phrase
modes.description: Of, to or for introducing a comparison or target in descriptive text.
modes.example: A Dies Irae sung in the style<< of>> an eager four-year-old, for example

modes.label: Adjective before a noun
modes.description: An adjective like long or broad right before a noun in animal or plant description.
modes.example: Even under gale force conditions the<< broad>> leaves remain rigid and immobile.

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in everyday descriptive writing, just before the thing being described is named.
